description.en: 15 Agent Skills and three mutually exclusive MCP rows (compare-mcp, decision-mcp, marketplace-mcp) for 12 Russian and Chinese marketplaces and classifieds: cross-marketplace price comparison and per-source search, product cards, seller details and reviews across Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Detsky Mir, Avito, AliExpress, Taobao, Megamarket, Lamoda, DNS, Citilink, and Cian real estate. Read-only, no API keys required; skills load on install while MCP rows stay disabled until RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR is set.
description.zh: 面向 12 家俄罗斯与中国电商及分类信息平台的 15 个 Agent 技能与三行互斥 MCP 配置（compare-mcp、decision-mcp、marketplace-mcp）：支持跨平台比价，以及 Wildberries、Ozon、Yandex Market、Detsky Mir、Avito、AliExpress（速卖通）、Taobao（淘宝）、Megamarket、Lamoda、DNS、Citilink 的商品搜索、详情卡、卖家信息与评论，外加 Cian 房产搜索。只读且无需 API Key；安装后 15 个技能立即可用，MCP 行默认关闭，设置 RU_MARKETPLACE_MCP_DIR 后按需启用。

description.en: MOKI Canvas for DSH — a local-first infinite canvas with mind maps, media, and two-way AI collaboration. MOKI 白板 for DSH。
DeepSeek Harness 情绪模块插件：感知/状态机/LLM复核/安全守卫/持久化/expressionStyle三档/对话框情绪chip开关（TypeScript + vitest）
适用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的GirlsBangCry 皮肤
DeepSeek Harness native plugin: Settings UI for the Roblox Studio MCP bridge - list connected Studio instances, pick the active one, and expose the selection to agents as runtime context.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that connects to the TM IM network (Agent Takeover webhook + REST).

Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): one Feishu topic = one dsh session, in-card approvals and questions, streaming cards, model and permission switching, Web settings page, long connection with no public endpoint.
在本地 DSH 里远程使用服务器上的 skills：SSH 连接远端主机，把远端 skill 目录接进 skill 注册表，并把命令执行与文件读写重定向到远端。
DSH QQ group/private chat tools: groups, history, send, faces, favorites, private chat, pokes (OneBot 11 / SnowLuma)
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接收发 QQ 群聊和私聊消息，还能发表情、戳一戳、翻历史记录。
